about: Golden set for ActionAgent. Each case is one 30 s window with speakers labelled 'Participant N' in order of first speaking; the reference date is Monday 2026-11-09 (UTC). Each expected action is a list of lowercase keyword groups a correct extraction's content must contain ('a|b' means either), plus the owner's label and the due date when the transcript states them. Reports of finished work, vague intentions, declined requests and pure decisions are not action items. Labels are the maintainer's judgement, written before any model was run against them.

cases.window:
Participant 1: The beta goes out on the 2nd, so we need release notes.
Participant 2: I'll write the release notes by Friday.
Participant 1: Perfect, thanks.

Participant 1: Can you file a bug for the CSV export crash?
Participant 2: Yep, I'll file it today with the stack trace.
Participant 3: And once it's fixed I'll let the customer know, they've asked twice.

Participant 1: I fixed the flaky login test yesterday.
Participant 2: And I already merged the dependency upgrades this morning.
Participant 1: So the pipeline is green again.

Participant 1: Morning all, sorry I'm late, the train was stuck.
Participant 2: No worries, we were just chatting about the match last night.
Participant 1: Don't remind me.

Participant 1: At some point we should really think about pricing for the API tier.
Participant 2: Yeah, someday. It's not urgent.
Participant 1: Agreed, nothing for now.

Participant 1: Could you take the schema migration this sprint?
Participant 2: I can't, I'm on call all week and the incident review is mine.
Participant 1: Understood, nobody else has capacity either, so it waits.

Participant 1: I'll send the revised deck to the client tomorrow, once legal signs off on the pricing slide.
Participant 2: Legal said they'd look at it tonight.
Participant 1: Great, then tomorrow it is.

Participant 1: So we're going with Stripe for invoicing.
Participant 2: Agreed, it's the cheapest at our volume.
Participant 3: Makes sense to me.

Participant 1: I'll set up the staging environment by Wednesday.
Participant 2: Could you also review my pull request for the auth change?
Participant 1: Sure, I'll review it today.

Participant 1: Where are we on the search rewrite?
Participant 2: About halfway, the indexer is done and I'm on the query side now.
Participant 1: Sounds on track.

Participant 1: The offsite needs a room for twenty people.
Participant 2: I'll book a room for the offsite, I know a place near the station.
Participant 1: Lovely, thank you.

Participant 1: Do we know if the vendor supports SAML?
Participant 2: Not sure, the docs are vague.
Participant 3: Is that even a requirement for the pilot?

Participant 1: Sam, you own the new onboarding doc, end of the month please.
Participant 2: Got it, end of November.
Participant 1: Thanks.

Participant 1: The Acme invoice is sixty days overdue.
Participant 2: I'll chase their finance team about the invoice.
Participant 1: Thank you, keep me posted.
